name: Deeprun Rat Roundup

angles.text: Monty's brother uses freshly captured Deeprun vermin to prepare rat kabobs, emphasizing that the rodents must remain alive until cooking lest the meat spoil.

faq.answer: Monty, a pirate-talking figure stationed down in the Deeprun Tram, hands out the task. He is looking for extra hands to help manage a vermin infestation along the subterranean transit line.
faq.q: Who gives the Deeprun Rat Roundup quest?

aliases: what does monty do with rats
faq.answer: Monty needs the Deeprun rats captured alive so they do not go sour before his brother can prepare them into rat kabobs. If the vermin die prematurely, the meat spoils.
faq.q: Why does Monty need the rats captured alive?

faq.answer: Monty provides an enchanted Rat Catcher's Flute. Playing its melody near the vermin charms them, causing the rats to follow behind the player back to Monty's station.
faq.q: How do you charm and round up the rats?

faq.answer: The quest takes place inside the Deeprun Tram, the subterranean engineering marvel connecting the Alliance cities of Stormwind and Ironforge. Monty is stationed along the tram platforms.
faq.q: Where does this task take place?

faq.answer: Monty mentions having a brother who cooks rat kabobs, but does not name him directly. His brother depends on a steady supply of fresh, living rats to avoid serving rancid meat.

aliases: why is a pirate in the tram
faq.answer: While Monty speaks in heavy nautical pirate slang, treating the tram like a ship's deck, he has taken up pest control duties down in the underground railway.
faq.q: Why does Monty talk like a pirate?

sections.body: Down in the subterranean tube of the Deeprun Tram, a colorful character named Monty struggles to keep the underground transit line clear of pests. Speaking in salty sea slang and treating the tramway like a ship's deck, Monty enlists passing travelers to help round up the scurrying vermin infesting the station.
sections.title: Vermin Beneath the Rails

sections.body: Rather than exterminating the rodents outright, Monty equips helpers with a Rat Catcher's Flute that plays a charming melody to entice the Deeprun rats into following along. The creatures must be brought back alive and kicking, as Monty's brother needs fresh specimens for culinary use: specifically, turning them into rat kabobs before the meat turns sour.
sections.title: A Questionable Delicacy

summary: Deeprun Rat Roundup is an Alliance task in the Deeprun Tram where players assist Monty with pest control. Using a charming musical flute, players round up living Deeprun rats to supply Monty's brother with fresh meat for rat kabobs.
